notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana available each turn to cast Temporal Manipulation and Acrobatic Maneuver.
description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost, taking an extra turn.
Cast Acrobatic Maneuver by paying its mana cost, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Temporal Manipulation and Acrobatic Maneuver from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.
